findings.finding: Project-Frankenstein documented that Frank kept saying the obsolete term AURA despite training because a hardcoded ARCHITECTURE FACT in core/app.py injected 'aura' into every thalamus-related prompt at runtime. The commit explicitly identifies that injected runtime context as overriding training data.
findings.current_mapping: Prompt-state injection is causally powerful enough to dominate model/training behavior. Therefore injected state/facts must be treated as versioned, provenance-bearing authority inputs rather than harmless context decoration.

findings.finding: The same architecture-fact map claimed a ThoughtSeedVAE architecture that the patch states did not exist; the fix replaced it with the actual Subconscious Actor-Critic mechanism.
findings.current_mapping: A stale or invented compact architecture summary can make the model confidently report nonexistent internal mechanisms even when the underlying runtime differs. Current FRANK/Clay prompt-state projections must be generated from verified state or exact versioned manifests, not hand-maintained lore.

findings.finding: The repair was not only textual: AURA identifiers were renamed across thalamus channel definitions, dataclass/state fields, consciousness-daemon caches, hypothesis documentation and tests, demonstrating that correcting the injected fact alone would have left schema/runtime drift unresolved.
findings.current_mapping: Prompt projection, authoritative state schema, runtime identifiers and tests must move together under one versioned migration. Surface text correction without state/schema migration is insufficient.

negative_results_and_failure_modes: Hardcoded prompt facts can override trained/model knowledge and persist obsolete architecture names.
Compact injected architecture summaries can hallucinate nonexistent components if they are not generated from verified runtime/canonical state.
Renaming only the prompt-visible term can hide deeper state/schema drift across caches, channels, tests and downstream consumers.
Provider/model agreement with injected text is not independent evidence because the injection itself can be the cause of the answer.
